plan.seedRule: 771001 + familyIndex*1000 + sceneIndex*37; 12 scenes per eligible family
plan.assignment: Every listed scene runs both arms from initialization. History excludes missing family because no record exists to withhold.
plan.streams: Physical scene is identical; sensors keyed by view and aspiration epoch; pump error keyed by stroke index. Divergent actions may encounter different physical noise effects.
plan.failureRule: Any crash, unsupported assignment or missing pair blocks analysis; retain the complete assignment ledger and repair/rerun the entire frozen study version.
plan.limits: Exploratory finite synthetic population, not a laboratory safety claim. No tuning on these results. Paired uncertainty is conditional on model and scene population.

paired.method: Paired percentile bootstrap within fixed scenario-family strata. Independent scene/calibration seeds; not shared sessions.
